Cloudflare is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for its PKI and cryptographic systems team, working on the certificate and key infrastructure behind products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Access, and Tunnel. The work covers certificate lifecycle management, X.509 issuance and validation, HSM integration via PKCS#11, ACME-based issuance and renewal automation, Certificate Transparency logging, and Cloudflare's post-quantum cryptography migration. The core stack is systems programming in Go, Rust, or C/C++ against globally distributed services and Postgres-style databases for high-integrity data, with the role based in Austin, London, or Lisbon on a hybrid basis.
